name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: Godfrey, Fletcher, and Riverside belong to different artisans.
Either Wulfric goes with Riverside, or Fletcher goes with Oldwall — but not both.
Between Rowan and Wulfric, one goes with Cooper and the other with Fletcher.
Either Millpond goes with Fletcher or Oldwall goes with Rowan.

hints.text: From the clue “Godfrey, Fletcher, and Riverside belong to different artisans” — Godfrey can't go with Fletcher.
From the clue “Godfrey, Fletcher, and Riverside belong to different artisans” — Godfrey can't go with Riverside.

Suppose Godfrey went with Cooper — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Godfrey goes with Cooper.
Godfrey goes with Cooper, so it can't also go with Mason.
Cooper goes with Godfrey, so Rowan can't go with Cooper.
Cooper goes with Godfrey, so Wulfric can't go with Cooper.
The clues force Rowan to go with Fletcher.
The clues force Wulfric to go with Fletcher.
…but now the clue “Between Rowan and Wulfric, one goes with Cooper and the other with Fletcher” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Godfrey does not go with Cooper.

Rowan goes with Cooper, and Riverside goes with Cooper, so Rowan goes with Riverside.

From the clue “Either Wulfric goes with Riverside, or Fletcher goes with Oldwall — but not both” — Fletcher must go with Oldwall.
From the clue “Either Millpond goes with Fletcher or Oldwall goes with Rowan” — Fletcher must go with Millpond.
Fletcher goes with Millpond, so it can't also go with Oldwall. But Fletcher was already shown to go with Oldwall — a contradiction.
So Rowan does not go with Cooper.
